Panel.Title: Planar Casino
Panel.Reroll: Has a reroll on the next pull

Bones.AllBust: Everyone rolled a 1: the house keeps the pot.
Bones.Rules: Choose how many d6 (bones) to shake. Highest total wins the pot; anyone who rolls a 1 loses. Minimum stake {ante}.

Board.Rules: Click a number to put a chip on it (right-click takes one back). The dealer rolls a d20: chips on that number pay {mult}×.

Slots.None: Three different symbols. A sad trumpet sounds.
Slots.RerollHint: Pick the dice you want to reroll.

Wheel.Claimed: That prize has already been won: no prize.
Wheel.Exhausted: The wheel spins and spins… and stops on nothing.

Heat.Title: Heat
Heat.Message: {name} has won {n} times at {game}. Security takes notice.

Rivals.Hint: Rivals sit at tables and play by their style. Bankroll is in chips.
Rivals.Name: Name

Pack.ResetConfirm: Forget the imported pack and use the generic one?
Pack.Default: The generic pack that ships with the module is in use. Import your own.
Pack.Invalid: The pack has {n} problems (details in the console, F12).
Pack.BadJSON: That file is not valid JSON.
Pack.ResetProgressConfirm: Reset paid jackpots, won wheel prizes, welcome gifts and fired whispers?

Ledger.DeleteConfirm: Remove this night from the ledger? Its journal page stays.
Ledger.Intro: Razor ledger for the session log.

Cage.Holds: {name} holds {razors} chips and {gp} gp (1 chip = {value} gp).

Adjust.Hint: Positive adds, negative removes. Stolen always removes.

Item.Description: A casino chip of {casino}, worth {value} gp at the cages.
Item.PlatinumDescription: An exceptionally rare platinum chip of {casino}. It is not cashed at the cages.

Chat.NoActor: Select your token or set your character first.

Notify.OnlyGM: Only the GM can do that.
Notify.NoGM: No GM is connected, so the casino is closed.
Notify.Timeout: The GM did not answer in time.
Notify.NotSeated: That seat isn't at this table.
Notify.ItemMissing: "{name}" was not found in the world or the compendiums. Import it (e.g. with Plutonium) and press Grant again.
Notify.AllWelcomed: Everyone already has their welcome gift.
Notify.NoPage: The page hasn't been created yet.

AutoGrant.Name: Grant item prizes automatically
AutoGrant.Hint: Find prize items by name (world, then compendiums) and add them to the winner. If one can't be found, the card gets a Grant button for the GM.

Heat.Name: Heat: wins before security notices
Heat.Hint: Whisper the GM when a character reaches this many wins at one game in a night. 0 = off.

WorldTime.Name: Wheel cooldown uses world time
WorldTime.Hint: On: one spin per creature per N hours of in-game time. Off: one spin per creature per casino night.

Pad.Hint: Name of a Planar Soundboard pad to play. Leave empty for none.

WheelFx.Name: Show the wheel animation
WheelFx.Hint: Plays the three-ring wheel on screen when anyone spins.
